html:
The first  10 years are spent focusing on mastering the immediate sensorimotor realm

"Unitization" in Fischer’s theory effectively turns a process (which requires reasoning) into a thing (which allows for perception). This is why profound insights often feel like "flashes" of vision rather than long chains of logic; you have just successfully consolidated a system into a unit.
